card.name: Candelabra
card.subject: A polished brass candelabra with a round weighted base, a turned central stem and two curved arms rising from the stem to either side; the stem and each arm end in a small cup holding a tall white candle, and each candle burns with a bright flame with a yellow-white glowing core and an orange tip, casting warm light on the brass.
card.hero_colors: polished brass, white candles, warm yellow flames
card.note: Seen from the front at the height of its middle: the round base shows only as a thin ellipse, as flat as the rims of the cups.
